mapper.sql: id, shop_id, open_user_id, current_session_id, last_message_id, message_count, user_message_count, ai_message_count, merchant_message_count, session_count, first_message_at, last_message_at, last_user_message_at, last_ai_reply_at, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mt_im_conversation ( shop_id, open_user_id, current_session_id, last_message_id, message_count, user_message_count, ai_message_count, merchant_message_count, session_count, first_message_at, last_message_at, last_user_message_at, last_ai_reply_at, version, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{shopId}, #{openUserId}, #{currentSessionId}, #{lastMessageId}, #{messageCount}, #{userMessageCount}, #{aiMessageCount}, #{merchantMessageCount}, #{sessionCount}, #{firstMessageAt}, #{lastMessageAt}, #{lastUserMessageAt}, #{lastAiReplyAt}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mt_im_conversation WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM mt_im_conversation WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND open_user_id = #{openUserId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM mt_im_conversation WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND open_user_id = #{openUserId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mt_im_conversation SET last_message_id = IF(last_message_at IS NULL OR #{eventTime} >= last_message_at, #{messageId}, last_message_id), message_count = message_count + 1, user_message_count = user_message_count + IF(#{senderRole} = 'USER', 1, 0), ai_message_count = ai_message_count + IF(#{senderRole} = 'AI', 1, 0), merchant_message_count = merchant_message_count + IF(#{senderRole} = 'MERCHANT', 1, 0), first_message_at = COALESCE(first_message_at, #{eventTime}), last_message_at = GREATEST(COALESCE(last_message_at, #{eventTime}), #{eventTime}), last_user_message_at = IF(#{senderRole} = 'USER', GREATEST(COALESCE(last_user_message_at, #{eventTime}), #{eventTime}), last_user_message_at), last_ai_reply_at = IF(#{senderRole} = 'AI', GREATEST(COALESCE(last_ai_reply_at, #{eventTime}), #{eventTime}), last_ai_reply_at), version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
